segments.name: Aesthetic solutions
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and markets energy-based minimally invasive aesthetic and medical treatment platforms, handpieces, applicators and consumables used by physicians and surgeons.
segments.evidence: Since 2010, we have launched sixteen product platforms: BodyTite, Optimas, Votiva, Contoura, Triton, EmbraceRF, EvolveX, Evoke, Morpheus8, EmpowerRF, Define, Envision, IgniteRF, OptimasMAX, Luxora, ApexRF and Solaria.

revenueModel.text: Plastic and facial surgeons, aesthetic surgeons, dermatologists and OB/GYNs pay for energy-based platforms, handpieces and applicators, and for training and support services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products, which we have historically marketed and sold to plastic and facial surgeons, aesthetic surgeons, dermatologists and OB/GYNs, may be used on a variety of body parts including the face, neck, abdomen, upper arms, thighs and intimate feminine regions.
